statement: In a randomised prospective comparison, a polyglycolic acid conduit gave sensory recovery at least equal to standard direct repair or graft in digital nerve gaps, with an advantage in gaps of 4 mm or more.

measurement.effect: equal or better recovery with the conduit in short gaps

evidence.note: earlier clinical series with the same conduit

replication.note: One randomised trial with a supporting earlier series from an overlapping group; widely adopted since.

limitations: short gaps; conduits are not used this way for long motor gaps

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
